The end of an athletic era draws to a close as ex-Belgravian SANDY LAW closes up his shoe making business to move to Eastbourne. For many years athletes have gone to Sandy's shop in Revelstoke Road, Wimbledon for a pair of hand made to measure running shoes, possibly his most famous customer being R…

These were made by Sandy Law of Wimbledon, a shoemaker and member of the club. In the 1920's Bill Fish was general factotem of the club, preparing the track, knocking in the spikes to tape the lanes in the hundred.

Made to measure shoes; track, country or road were available from Sandy Law, a Club member, at £1.2.6p per pair. By the way, from your excellent photo's I don't see many members with the Club badge sewn to the gold band.
